as_told.title: Nixon passed US UFO knowledge to the Soviet Union

plain: At a US-Soviet summit in the early 1970s, President Richard Nixon is said to have opened a small folder about UFOs and shown it to the Soviet leader Leonid Brezhnev, and the American moon flights stopped soon after. The story comes from Kiran Ilum Xenov, a former president of one of Russia's republics, in a December 2025 episode. He passes it on second-hand and links it to the last Soviet leader, Mikhail Gorbachev. Xenov says that after the others had left the room, the American president "had a small folder like this that he opened and showed" to Brezhnev. He adds that Yuri Andropov, a senior Soviet official, was present. In the same episode Michels repeats the point in his own words. He describes Nixon giving the Soviet Union information in the 1970s about what the CIA, the US spy agency, and the White House knew about UFOs and aliens. Michels does not mention the folder or the end of the moon flights. If true, it would mean the two Cold War rivals quietly shared their UFO secrets at the highest level.
